front: Explain the mental model of Byte stream (how the system thinks).

front: Explain the mental model of Bitrate streaming (how the system thinks).
back: Bitrate streaming means encoding the same content at multiple bitrates/resolutions so the player (ABR) switches renditions without rebuffering. The ladder is the set of rungs; the manifest (HLS/DASH) advertises BANDWIDTH + RESOLUTION per rung.

front: What are the production-safe defaults for Bitrate streaming?

front: Symptom: Quality cliff between rungs — what do you check and fix?

front: Symptom: ABR switch flicker — what do you check and fix?

front: Symptom: Blurry on motion — what do you check and fix?

front: Symptom: Audio sync drift — what do you check and fix?

front: Symptom: Live uplink unstable — what do you check and fix?

front: Gotcha with Bitrate streaming: what silently fails?
